Name: I hate this small Farm
Author: heathinwillows
Description:
this is like a revision of my first ever farm "hidden haven farm" life's been pretty chill really, college aint really that bad, just had my birthday last nov 26th and it was one of the best birthdays ive ever had yet.
i recommend playing this farm with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF[/url] mods like:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25435]Cozy Backyard[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28346]Enchanted Garden[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25942]Entrance to Narnia[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28298]Mountain Gardens[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29014]Secret Garden Springs[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28445?tab=description]Vulkan Cave
[/url]
only if you want extra building and farming space

also you guys can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16873]Easy Farm Switcher[/url] mod so you could switch farms at ease mid game without losing ur progress, so you wont have to start a new save just to try a new farm:)))))

there's now 2 starter gift options, make sure you choose one first on the config before starting a new save

Farmer Starter Gift:
Strawberry Seeds - 15
Scarecrow - 1
Seed Maker - 1
Preserves Jar - 1
Dehydrator - 1

Fisher Starter Gift:
